rule_title: TTP 1021.002 - Massive Remote Service Access via Named Pipe (svcctl)
description: Detects a high volume of remote accesses to the Service Control Manager named pipe (svcctl) over IPC$ from a single source in a short window. Each access generates a unique logon session, indicating automated/scripted remote service manipulation consistent with lateral movement tools such as Impacket services.py or similar frameworks.
